description: NCS is a nonprofit in Londrina, Brazil. Our project, Radar do Bairro, uses NISAR radar and explainable ML to detect floods and land change in low-income neighborhoods, then crosses it with census data to show who is affected. After the hackathon it becomes a real community program. I’m a computational chemist (Python). Looking for: ML, SAR/remote sensing, GIS/web maps, design and storytelling. Beginners welcome! PT/EN.
